text:
frank li: Quick note 1 I'm refreshing the 'hello-ignite' quickstart to match SDK v8 auth + a tiny deploy section for containers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3601. Running the example locally I get a 401. Anyone free to sanity-check?

anya petrov: ping 1 send the error snippet/logs?

frank li: server returns HTTP 401 - "missing api key". Locally I was following the old README that uses REDWOOD_TOKEN. Looks like SDKv8 expects REDWOOD_API_KEY and the helper name changed.

omar rivas: yep, helper is createClientFromEnv now. We intentionally renamed to be explicit. For quickstarts, we prefer a 1-line env export + helper call.

frank li: thanks 1 plan: replace env var, swap in createClientFromEnv(), add Node + Python minimal snippets, and add a one-sentence Docker caution.

tasha mendel: Also add a short KMS pointer for enterprise users who rely on instance roles. We had a ticket last month where docs omission tripped people. One sentence with link to /enterprise/kms should be enough.

link-bot: linkcheck: docs/quickstart/hello-ignite.md line 40 -> https://old-auth.example/ (redirect).

frank li: I'll update to /docs/auth and add the KMS cross-link.

anya petrov: Example suggestions: Node minimal:
```js
import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = createClientFromEnv();
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', prompt: 'Hello' });
console.log(out.text);
```
Python minimal:
```py
from redwood_inference import create_client_from_env
client = create_client_from_env()
res = client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='Hello')
print(res.text)
```

omar rivas: Add a minimal bash export block (no quotes) and an explicit admonition not to commit keys to images. For Docker, we usually show ARG + comment and link to /docs/security/secrets.

frank li: added bash block:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<YOUR_KEY>
# optional (KMS): export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=projects/...
```
And updated Dockerfile to include `ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY` + comment about runtime injection.

build-bot: CI started for PR #3601 1 lint, linkcheck, mdspell.

link-bot: linkcheck: warning: redirect found for /docs/authentication -> /docs/auth. Consider updating target.

frank li: switched to /docs/auth to avoid redirect, pushed. Also added a tiny callout under "Auth": "Enterprise KMS customers: see /enterprise/kms for instance-role and KMS key examples."

anya petrov: nit: trim the long paragraph in the Auth section to two bullets and keep examples <=6 lines. Keeps the quickstart skimmable.

frank li: trimmed and pushed. Squashed the small fixes.

omar rivas: Can you assign me and tasha as reviewers and add a follow-up issue to add a CI smoke test that builds quickstarts? We want a basic no-credential build and lint smoke on PRs.

frank li: assigned reviewers and added TODO "CI smoke test: build quickstarts" in PR description.

build-bot: MDSpell: passed. linkcheck: passed. All checks succeeded for PR #3601.

anya petrov: LGTM. Small wording nit I left inline but not blocking. Merge when ready.

frank li: merging now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

build-bot: PR #3601 merged by anya petrov 1 site deploy queued.

build-bot: deploy: staging build started 2026-04-18T09:45:00Z.

frank li: Verified staging render; snippets look correct and the Docker note + KMS pointer are present. I'll watch production deploy.

omar rivas: Nice catch on the env rename 1 will open backport PRs for hello-chat and hello-embed after this lands.

tasha mendel: I'll file the CI smoke test issue this week and link to this thread so we can triage priority.

frank li: closing thread 1 thanks for the quick reviews and suggestions.
